outcome: changing trends in the etiology and management of urinary fistula
cohort: 20 patients who underwent surgical repair of urinary fistula at a tertiary care hospital in New Delhi, India
finding: The most common cause of urinary fistula was gynecologic surgery (65%), followed by obstructed labor (25%) and cesarean section (10%), and the vaginal approach for repair had a high success rate (85%).
mod_finding: 25% of urinary fistulae occurred following obstructed labor, while 10% occurred after cesarean section.
